title: Audio seems to stop the next command in RPG Maker MZ

posts.author: SergioGoldman
posts.body:
Hello,
I have just started using RPG Maker MZ and I am running into a big issue.
I would like to have a narrator speak for 3min09 and then ask a question, then prompt a choice "yes" or "no", but I can't seem to make it work.
I can either have the narrator speak and have the choice on from the very first second, or not display the choice at all.
Here's my event pannel.
Can someone help?

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
12 * 900 = 10800
10800 + 600 = 11400
11400 / 60 = 190
190 / 60 = 3,166666666666667
So that should be just above 3 Minutes 16 seconds.
Does the choice pop up if you use less waiting? You can also use a script call
this.wait(11.340)
to avoid having to spam these wait commands over and over.

posts.author: SergioGoldman
posts.body:
Hi!
Thanks for your quick answer.
Yes, in the second part, after the choice. If I input 1260 frames instead of 2160, the rest triggers (earlier, but still).
I tried the script call, which was new for me.
Here, the audio waits 240 frames and starts reading the audio while leaving the choice. Therefore, RPG Maker does not take my script into account.

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
Uhh, I believe you need a ; at the end of it to make it work.
this.wait(11.340); basically.

posts.author: Robro33
posts.body: drop the separator entirely. its not needed and is causing it to be read as 11 frames instead of 11340

posts.author: SergioGoldman
posts.body: It works!!! Thank you so much ot the both of you !

posts.body: "The choice doesn't trigger" means what exactly? It doesn't show up? Or the choice you selected doesn't process? Does it not show up at all, or is the timing just off? If it worked once and now doesn't, do you have anything else running that could interfere?

posts.body: I did not have the choice window, it would not display, but now it seems to be fixed, thank you
